CFDLean.Coordinates.decode.eq_1.type:
∀ (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x = { density := x 0, momentum := ![x 1, x 2, x 3], energy := x 4 }
CFDLean.Coordinates.decode.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Coordinates.decode.eq_1

CFDLean.Coordinates.dot_three.type: ∀ (v w : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.dot v w = v 0 * w 0 + v 1 * w 1 + v 2 * w 2
CFDLean.Coordinates.dot_three.name: CFDLean.Coordinates.dot_three

CFDLean.Coordinates.encode.eq_1.type:
∀ (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3),

CFDLean.Coordinates.encode.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Coordinates.encode.eq_1

CFDLean.Coordinates.reconstruct_area.type: ∀ (S : CFDLean.Vector 3), S ≠ 0 → S = fun i => CFDLean.Coordinates.area S * CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S i
CFDLean.Coordinates.reconstruct_area.name: CFDLean.Coordinates.reconstruct_area

CFDLean.Coordinates.squareSum_three.type: ∀ (v : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.squareSum v = v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 + v 2 ^ 2
CFDLean.Coordinates.squareSum_three.name: CFDLean.Coordinates.squareSum_three

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinatePress.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinatePressure γ x = CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x)
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinatePress.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinatePressure.eq_1

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x = (x 4 + CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinatePressure γ x) / x 0
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy.eq_1.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy.eq_1

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_coo.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  x 0 ≠ 0 → HasFDerivAt (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ n) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian γ x n) x
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_coo.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_coordinateFlux

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_int.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  x 0 ≠ 0 →
    S ≠ 0 →
      HasFDerivAt (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S)
        (CFDLean.Coordinates.area S • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian γ x (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S)) x
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_int.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_integratedFlux

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_nor.type:
∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  HasFDerivAt (fun y => CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y).momentum n)
    (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n) x
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_nor.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_normalMomentum

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_nor.type:
∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  x 0 ≠ 0 →
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y).momentum n / y 0)
      ((1 / x 0) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n) x
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_nor.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_normalVelocity

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pre.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  x 0 ≠ 0 →
    HasFDerivAt (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinatePressure γ) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x) x
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pre.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_pressure

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian.eq_1.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian γ x n =
    ContinuousLinearMap.pi
      ![CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n,
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n +
          n 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x,
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n +
          n 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x,
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n +
          n 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x,
        CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n •
            (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 + CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x) +
          CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.enthalpy γ x • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n]
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian.eq_1.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian.eq_1

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian_action.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian_action

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian_smul.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (a : ℝ),
  (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian γ x fun i => a * n i) = a • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian γ x n
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian_smul.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian_smul

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement.type:
∀ (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement x n =
    CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n -
      CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) n • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalIncrement.eq_1

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum..type:
∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum n =
    n 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 + n 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
      n 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum..name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.normalMomentum.eq_1

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDiffere.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential γ x =
    (γ - 1) •
      (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 4 -
          (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 0 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 1 +
              CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 1 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 2 +
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x 2 • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 3) +
        (CFDLean.squareSum (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x) / 2) • CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.projection 0)
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDiffere.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressureDifferential.eq_1

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressure_formul.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinatePressure γ x = (γ - 1) * (x 4 - (x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 + x 3 ^ 2) / (2 * x 0))
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressure_formul.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.pressure_formula

CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity.eq_1.type:
∀ (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x i = (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x).momentum i / x 0
CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity.eq_1.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity.eq_1

CFDLean.Primitive.toConservative.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (W : CFDLean.Primitive d),
  CFDLean.Primitive.toConservative γ W =
    { density := W.density, momentum := fun i => W.density * W.velocity i,
      energy := W.pressure / (γ - 1) + W.density * CFDLean.squareSum W.velocity / 2 }

CFDLean.physicalFlux.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d) (S : CFDLean.Vector d),
  CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S =
    { density := CFDLean.dot U.momentum S,
      momentum := fun i =>
        U.momentum i * (CFDLean.dot U.momentum S / U.density) + CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U * S i,
      energy := (U.energy + CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U) * (CFDLean.dot U.momentum S / U.density) }
CFDLean.physicalFlux.eq_1.name: CFDLean.physicalFlux.eq_1

CFDLean.physicalFlux_add.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d) (S T : CFDLean.Vector d),
  (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U fun i => S i + T i) =
    { density := (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).density + (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T).density,
      momentum := fun i => (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).momentum i + (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T).momentum i,
      energy := (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).energy + (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T).energy }
CFDLean.physicalFlux_add.name: CFDLean.physicalFlux_add

CFDLean.physicalFlux_mul.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d) (S : CFDLean.Vector d) (a : ℝ),
  (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U fun i => a * S i) =
    { density := a * (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).density,
      momentum := fun i => a * (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).momentum i,
      energy := a * (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).energy }
CFDLean.physicalFlux_mul.name: CFDLean.physicalFlux_mul

CFDLean.physicalFlux_reverse.type:

  (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U fun i => -S i) =
    { density := -(CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).density, momentum := fun i => -(CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).momentum i,
      energy := -(CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).energy }
CFDLean.physicalFlux_reverse.name: CFDLean.physicalFlux_reverse

CFDLean.physicalFlux_zero.type:
